answer: Proposal: at one surprise 10-second window, each key uploads a distinct 20-GiB nonce-masked stream of nebula tiles, willow imagery and jetty telemetry to two independent audited receivers. Receivers sign complete byte counts and hashes; proposed validators forfeit pending epoch pay if either signed receipt is absent, late or reused. The cheapest farm shares a model and rents a bulk link, but each added clone consumes another simultaneous 20-GiB upload to each receiver: leased capacity is not pooled bytes. This costly rule also burdens honest entrants; MinePoA does not enforce it.
